name: Essential Addons for WooCommerce
author: CodeConfig

sections.description:
Essential Addons for WooCommerce enhances your store with advanced features for carts, checkout, product display, and better customer experiences.

Key Features:

  • Advanced Cart Management: Save, share, and restore carts.
  • Custom Checkout Fields: Add or modify fields in your checkout form.
  • Mini Cart and Popup Cart: Enhance the cart experience with stylish popups and mini cart designs.
  • Product Quick View: Let customers preview products without leaving the page.
  • Purchase Notifications: Create urgency with live sales notifications.
  • Ajax Search: Enable fast, responsive product search with SKU support.
  • Shop Filters: Advanced filters for categories, attributes, price ranges, and more.

Perfect for eCommerce store owners aiming to provide a seamless shopping experience and increase conversions.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/essential-addons-for-woocommerce/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Configure the settings under WooCommerce > Essential Addons.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work seamlessly with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Does the plugin affect my site’s speed?

No, the plugin is optimized for performance and will not slow down your site.

Can I customize the features?

Yes, the plugin provides extensive customization options in its settings.
